description: Send an in-app announcement and attempt device pushes to this event's current guests. Does NOT send email or SMS. For email updates use edit_email_campaign (emailType announcement, audienceType event_participants, eventId), prepare, inspect_email_workspace review, then send_email_campaign. For texts use get_sms_announcement_audience, preview_sms_announcement, send_sms_announcement. Review each requested channel and report its actual receipt; Firebase acceptance is not device delivery. To invite new people, use send_invitations for app invitations or reviewed event_promotion email.

request_id.description: Stable retry key. Reuse it after a lost response.
